label: À La Carte
title: Dining Room
description: Urban Hearth is designed for those who love to dine well. The room is intimate, lively, and comfortable, with a quiet sense of luxury that invites guests to linger — over another glass of wine, another course, another conversation. Hospitality is personal, creating an experience that feels refined and at ease. Our dining room is a place to gather, celebrate, and connect.

The à la carte menu, available in the dining room, bar, and salon, follows the seasons. Rooted in New England ingredients and informed by culinary traditions from around the world, the menu changes as ingredients come into season and new ideas emerge.

We approach our beverage program with the same care and curiosity that guide our kitchen. The wine list features both celebrated producers and emerging voices, with an emphasis on character, place, and balance. Seasonal cocktails showcase exceptional spirits and house-made ingredients, alongside a broad selection of beer, cider, and non-alcoholic beverages.

label: Chef's Tasting Menu
title: Chef's Counter
description: Six seats at the kitchen pass. A multi-course menu prepared by the Chef — $190 per person, with optional wine pairings, spirit pairings or spirit free pairings.

label: Bar & Salon
title: Bar & Salon
description: Natural wines, craft cocktails, and small plates in a relaxed room that keeps its own hours. Walk-ins always welcome; reservations recommended for groups of four or more.
The salon is available for private gatherings. To book, reach out to our concierge team at concierge@urbanhearth.net.
